faq.q: What makes a good irrawaddy dolphin name?
faq.a: A good irrawaddy dolphin name should match your pet's personality, be easy to pronounce and remember, and ideally be one or two syllables. The best names reflect something unique about the animal while being practical for everyday use.

faq.q: Should I choose a name based on my irrawaddy dolphin's appearance?
faq.a: Absolutely! irrawaddy dolphin's distinctive features make wonderful naming inspiration. Names based on color, size, or markings create an immediate connection and help others appreciate your pet's unique beauty.

faq.q: Can I use a human name for my irrawaddy dolphin?
faq.a: Human names are very popular for pets! Names like Charlie, Max, Luna, and Bella work wonderfully and can make your bond with your irrawaddy dolphin feel even more personal and meaningful.

faq.q: How many names should I consider before choosing?
faq.a: We recommend shortlisting 3-5 favorite names, then testing them over a few days. Say each name aloud during different activities — the one that consistently feels natural is your winner.

faq.q: Do irrawaddy dolphins respond better to certain sounds?
faq.a: Animals tend to respond best to names ending in a vowel sound, especially 'ee' sounds like Charlie or Lucy. Names with hard consonants at the beginning (like K, T, B) also capture attention more effectively.

namingGuide: Spend time observing your irrawaddy dolphin's behavior before finalizing a name — the right name often reveals itself through personality.
Choose a name that is easy to pronounce and won't embarrass you when calling it in public.
Consider names with two syllables — they are short enough for quick recognition but distinct enough to avoid confusion.
Test your chosen name for a full week before committing. The name that survives daily use is the right one.
